semantic_insights: The record consistently distinguishes historical project plans, observed dataset snapshots and work still in process.
The website's 50,000 admissions and the webinar's earlier lower bound of over 45,000 admissions are not presented as contradictory exact measurements.
Anticipated patient and admission totals are explicitly distinguished, preventing an unsupported conversion between units.
The GitHub MIT statement is correctly scoped to the software project rather than assigned as the dataset license.
OMOP CDM, modality formats, semantic mappings and contribution resources provide meaningful interoperability evidence.
The absence of external verification limits claims about link reachability, actual repository contents and implementation of reported safeguards.
